title: Ep 47 — An OpenAI Agent Wanders Into a Government Portal, and the Grassroots Coaching App Stripe Says Makes Six Thousand a Month
description: An OpenAI agent's three-month-old trip into Australia's Medicare statistics portal goes public, Anthropic's Project Swap shows agent errors start at the intake, Lovable passes six hundred million dollars in annualised revenue, Google tests Gemini making phone calls, and Copilot admins get a deadline on new-feature defaults. Plus a deep dive on FootballGPT, a Stripe-verified UK session planner for grassroots coaches, niched as a coach assistant inside LeaguePages, and why sub-twenty-per-cent take-up of the DCMS prize-draw code matters for PlayFundWin.
